prompt:
Goal: Create a premium vertical 9:16 Paris travel-journal scrapbook collage with a warm, cinematic editorial aesthetic, featuring a stylish young woman with long naturally wavy dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, soft glam makeup, hoop earrings, olive button-up shirt, and black jeans at a Paris café by the Seine during golden hour.

Canvas: Vertical 9:16 composition, high-resolution, layered scrapbook poster. Use warm sunset light, creamy beige paper textures, soft shadows, elegant travel-magazine color grading, and realistic paper collage depth.

Main scene: The upper two-thirds is a photorealistic cinematic café terrace beside the Seine River. The woman sits at a small round brass café table, leaning her cheek on one hand and smiling gently toward the viewer. Behind her are the Eiffel Tower, the Seine, an arched bridge, river boats, Parisian buildings, leafy tree branches, and a glowing pastel orange-pink sunset sky. At the far left, include a black-green café awning reading CAFÉ DE PARIS, a chalkboard sign, flower boxes with pink flowers, warm interior café lights, and classic woven bistro chairs.

Visible table items: Include exactly 6 discrete tabletop items in the main scene: 1 white coffee cup with small Paris café lettering, 1 saucer, 1 croissant on a plate, 1 small glass vase with white daisies, 1 vintage black camera, and 1 beige travel book labeled “Good Trips Good Mood.”

Scrapbook lower section: The bottom third becomes a tactile collage on textured cream paper. Include exactly 4 layered paper elements: 1 large watercolor-style postcard/photo print on the lower left, 1 torn checklist note on the lower right, 1 muted sage-green torn paper patch beneath the checklist, and 1 Paris postal stamp graphic near the lower center. Add subtle tape, deckled edges, wrinkles, and shadows.

Inset postcard image: The lower-left print shows the same woman from behind at the same café table, looking toward the Eiffel Tower across the Seine. Render it as a watercolor/travel sketch with soft paper texture, deckled border, muted pastel colors, lamp posts, leafy branches, boats, bridge, and Paris skyline.

Checklist note: On the torn note at lower right, handwrite the heading Same Place Different Feelings. Include exactly 4 checked checklist items: “Good Coffee,” “Beautiful Views,” “Happier Me,” and “More to Explore.” Add a simple line drawing of a camera beneath the checklist and a taped sprig of tiny white flowers along the right edge.

Handwritten text elements: Add exactly 6 separate handwritten/printed text areas across the collage: 1 café awning text “CAFÉ DE PARIS,” 1 chalkboard phrase “Bon café / Belles journées / Grands rêves” with a small heart, 1 upper-right quote Paris is always a good idea with a heart, 1 lower-left note “Travel / Breathe / Be Happy” with a heart, 1 lower-right checklist heading and four checked items, and 1 bottom quote Collect moments for a brighter tomorrow with a heart. Also include 1 circular postal stamp reading “PARIS FRANCE” with an Eiffel Tower icon and wavy postmark lines.

Visual style: Blend photorealistic luxury travel photography in the main scene with handcrafted scrapbook textures below. Use golden-hour highlights, shallow depth of field, romantic Paris atmosphere, soft bokeh, natural skin tones, realistic reflections on the table and river, and delicate black handwritten script.

Constraints: Keep the composition elegant and uncluttered, preserve the exact counts of objects and text areas, make all text legible, avoid extra people in the foreground, avoid watermarks or logos, and maintain a cohesive beige, sage, pink, brass, and sunset-gold palette.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张 9:16 竖版高级巴黎旅行日记剪贴簿拼贴画，采用温暖的电影感编辑风格，主角为 一位时尚的年轻女性，留着深棕色自然波浪长发，扎着高马尾，化着精致的淡妆，佩戴圆环耳环，身穿橄榄色衬衫和黑色牛仔裤，场景设定在黄金时刻的塞纳河畔巴黎咖啡馆。

画布：9:16 竖版构图，高分辨率，分层剪贴簿海报。使用温暖的日落光线、奶油色纸张纹理、柔和的阴影、优雅的旅游杂志调色以及逼真的纸张拼贴深度。

主体场景：上方三分之二为塞纳河畔写实的电影感咖啡馆露台。女性坐在圆形的黄铜咖啡桌旁，单手托腮，微笑着看向镜头。她身后是埃菲尔铁塔、塞纳河、拱桥、游船、巴黎建筑、茂密的树枝以及粉橙色的柔和日落天空。最左侧包含一个黑绿色的咖啡馆遮阳篷，上面写着 CAFÉ DE PARIS，以及黑板招牌、装有粉色花朵的花箱、温暖的咖啡馆室内灯光和经典的编织藤椅。

桌面可见物品：主体场景中需包含 6 件独立的桌面物品：1 个印有巴黎咖啡馆小字样的白色咖啡杯、1 个杯托、1 个盘子里的牛角面包、1 个插有小白雏菊的小玻璃花瓶、1 台复古黑色相机以及 1 本标有“Good Trips Good Mood”的米色旅行手册。

剪贴簿下半部分：底部三分之一为纹理奶油纸上的触感拼贴。包含 4 个分层纸质元素：左下方 1 张大尺寸水彩风格明信片/照片打印件、右下方 1 张撕裂的清单便签、清单下方 1 块灰绿色的撕裂纸片，以及底部中心附近 1 个巴黎邮戳图案。添加细微的胶带、毛边、褶皱和阴影。

明信片插图：左下方的打印件展示了同一位女性在同一张咖啡桌旁背对镜头的画面，望向塞纳河对岸的埃菲尔铁塔。将其渲染为水彩/旅行素描风格，带有柔和的纸张纹理、毛边边框、柔和的粉彩色调，以及路灯、树枝、船只、桥梁和巴黎天际线。

清单便签：在右下方的撕裂便签上，手写标题 Same Place Different Feelings。包含 4 个已勾选的清单项目：“Good Coffee”、“Beautiful Views”、“Happier Me”和“More to Explore”。在清单下方添加一个简单的相机线条画，并在右侧边缘贴上一小束细小的白色花朵。

手写文字元素：在整个拼贴画中添加 6 个独立的手写/印刷文字区域：1 处咖啡馆遮阳篷文字“CAFÉ DE PARIS”、1 处黑板短语“Bon café / Belles journées / Grands rêves”并配有一个小爱心、1 处右上角引语 Paris is always a good idea 并配有一个爱心、1 处左下角便签“Travel / Breathe / Be Happy”并配有一个爱心、1 处右下角清单标题及四个已勾选项目，以及 1 处底部引语 Collect moments for a brighter tomorrow 并配有一个爱心。此外，包含 1 个圆形邮戳，上面写着“PARIS FRANCE”，配有埃菲尔铁塔图标和波浪形邮戳线。

视觉风格：将主体场景中写实的奢华旅行摄影与下方的纯手工剪贴簿纹理相结合。使用黄金时刻的高光、浅景深、浪漫的巴黎氛围、柔和的焦外成像、自然的肤色、桌面上和河流中逼真的倒影，以及精致的黑色手写字体。

约束条件：保持构图优雅简洁，严格遵守物品和文字区域的数量，确保所有文字清晰可辨，避免前景出现额外人物，避免水印或 Logo，并保持米色、灰绿色、粉色、黄铜色和日落金色的协调色调。
